content.text:
**My answer:** I sort of get the map now. There's bank stuff (עו"ש, פיקדון, קרן כספית), tax-break stuff (קרן השתלמות, which I already have through work), and the do-it-yourself route. For me that's a "חשבון ניירות ערך" at a bank or investment house, putting the money into the S&P 500 "דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו". I'm fairly sure that's the one to look into. What decided it was seeing "מדד S&P 500" right there under "במה הכסף מושקע". But the page doesn't say which one is better for me, or anything about fees, so I'm not doing anything today.

**How it went:**
- **Where I looked.** First the top heading, "מדריך – כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה". That's exactly what I wanted, so I stayed. Next, "מאיפה להתחיל" pointed me to קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן כספית. I have the first two through work already, so OK. Then I went through the cards under "איפה הכסף מוחזק": I read the bank group, the tax-break group, and "לבחירה עצמית" ("חשבון ניירות ערך"). Then the cards under "במה הכסף מושקע", where I stopped on S&P 500. The last screen is just the end of the page.
- **What I skipped.** "פרישה" (pension stuff, I already have one), "לילדים", "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים", "קופת גמל להשקעה" (sounds like something for old people), all the אג"ח cards, the "ניהול אישי" cards, the "מה האתר עוד לא מכסה" box, the footer and the small grey line at the bottom. I didn't open a single card.
- **Words I didn't get:** מק"מ (it shows up twice), אג"ח צמודה / לא צמודה, "קופון", "חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו", MSCI AC World vs MSCI World, "מסלול כללי", "תשואת המק"מ".
- **Where I hesitated.** In the index part there are about nine cards that all look the same (MSCI, נאסד"ק, ת"א-35/125/90…), and the page doesn't recommend any of them. If S&P 500 hadn't been in there, that's where I'd have given up.
- **What bothered me.** There's not one number on the page. No fees in shekels, no returns, nothing about how much to put in. The page gives no clear next step. It doesn't tell me what to do with 30,000 ₪, so I'd close it and probably ask friends at work.

input.answer: The page showed me the kinds of products: bank stuff, tax-break stuff like קרן השתלמות, and doing it yourself through a חשבון ניירות ערך. For my money the one worth looking into is a securities account with a fund that tracks the S&P 500, but the page gives no fees or next step, so I'm not doing anything today.
